# GenAI Agents

> A community-driven collection of 59 runnable Jupyter notebooks implementing Generative AI agents, from a single conversational bot to multi-agent systems, self-improving agents and complete applications. Each notebook is a self-contained tutorial covering the problem, the agent design, the implementation and a working run. Frameworks include LangGraph, AutoGen, PydanticAI and from-scratch agent loops. This is a teaching repository rather than a framework, so there is no package to install. Authored by Nir Diamant. Licensed under a custom non-commercial license.

## Core Documents

- [README](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/README.md): Overview, the full tutorial index and quick start.
- [CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): How to add an agent tutorial and the pull request checklist.
- [AGENTS](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/AGENTS.md): Repository conventions for AI coding agents.
- [Tutorials index](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/README.md): Index of the notebooks.
- [LICENSE](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/LICENSE): Custom non-commercial license. Read before any commercial reuse.

## Start Here: Agent Fundamentals

- [Simple Conversational Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/simple_conversational_agent.ipynb): A chat agent with memory. The smallest useful starting point.
- [Simple Conversational Agent with PydanticAI](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/simple_conversational_agent-pydanticai.ipynb): The same agent built on PydanticAI.
- [Simple Question Answering Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/simple_question_answering_agent.ipynb): Single-turn question answering.
- [Agent While Loop From Scratch](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/agent_while_loop_from_scratch.ipynb): The agent loop with no framework, so the mechanics are visible.
- [Task-Oriented Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/task_oriented_agent.ipynb): An agent that pursues a goal rather than answering turn by turn.
- [LangGraph Tutorial](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/langgraph-tutorial.ipynb): Graph-based agent orchestration with LangGraph.
- [MCP Tutorial](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/mcp-tutorial.ipynb): Connecting an agent to tools over the Model Context Protocol.

## Memory and State

- [Memory-Enhanced Conversational Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/memory_enhanced_conversational_agent.ipynb): Short-term and long-term memory in one agent.
- [Memory Agent Tutorial](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/memory-agent-tutorial.ipynb): Memory patterns applied to an agent.

## Multi-Agent Systems

- [Multi-Agent Collaboration System](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/multi_agent_collaboration_system.ipynb): Multiple specialized agents coordinating on one task.
- [Research Team with AutoGen](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/research_team_autogen.ipynb): A research team built with AutoGen.
- [Blog Writer Swarm](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/blog_writer_swarm.ipynb): A swarm that plans, drafts and edits long-form writing.
- [Database Discovery Fleet](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/database_discovery_fleet.ipynb): A fleet of agents exploring and documenting a database.
- [Grocery Management Agents System](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/grocery_management_agents_system.ipynb): Cooperating agents over a household domain.

## Self-Improvement and Evaluation

- [Self-Improving Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/self_improving_agent.ipynb): An agent that learns from its own past runs.
- [Self-Healing Code](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/self_healing_code.ipynb): Detect a failure, diagnose it and repair the code.
- [Trace-Based Agent Evaluation](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/trace_based_agent_evaluation.ipynb): Evaluate an agent from its execution traces.
- [End-to-End Testing Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/e2e_testing_agent.ipynb): An agent that writes and runs end-to-end tests.
- [Human-in-the-Loop Approval Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/human_in_the_loop_approval_agent.ipynb): Pausing for human approval before consequential actions.
- [Graph Inspector System](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/graph_inspector_system_langgraph.ipynb): Inspecting and debugging a LangGraph agent graph.

## Research and Analysis Agents

- [Scientific Paper Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/scientific_paper_agent_langgraph.ipynb): Find, read and summarize scientific papers.
- [Systematic Review of Scientific Articles](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/systematic_review_of_scientific_articles.ipynb): Automating a systematic literature review.
- [Search the Internet and Summarize](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/search_the_internet_and_summarize.ipynb): Web search plus synthesis.
- [News TL;DR](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/news_tldr_langgraph.ipynb): Condensing a news feed into a briefing.
- [AInsight](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/ainsight_langgraph.ipynb): An insight-generation pipeline.
- [Content Intelligence](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/ContentIntelligence.ipynb): Content analysis and classification.
- [Contextual Quoting Agentic System](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/contextual_quoting_agentic_system.ipynb): Quoting sources with the context that justifies them.
- [Simple Data Analysis Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/simple_data_analysis_agent_notebook.ipynb): An agent that analyzes a dataset and reports findings.
- [Simple Data Analysis Agent with PydanticAI](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/simple_data_analysis_agent_notebook-pydanticai.ipynb): The same agent on PydanticAI.
- [AI-Driven ML and Data Science Assistant](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/ai_driven_ml_and_datascience_assistant.ipynb): An assistant for modelling workflows.

## Business and Productivity Agents

- [Document Intake Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/document_intake_agent_langgraph.ipynb): Ingesting, classifying and routing documents.

- [Car Buyer Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/car_buyer_agent_langgraph.ipynb): An agent that researches and compares purchases.
- [ShopGenie](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/ShopGenie.ipynb): A shopping research and recommendation agent.
- [Weather Disaster Management Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/Weather_Disaster_Management_AI_AGENT.ipynb): Decision support over weather and disaster data.
- [Social Media Publishing Agent](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/social_media_publishing_agent_publora_langgraph.ipynb): Drafting and scheduling social posts.
- [GenAI Career Assistant](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/agent_hackathon_genAI_career_assistant.ipynb): Career guidance built at a hackathon.

- [GIF Animation Generator](https://github.com/NirDiamant/GenAI_Agents/blob/main/all_agents_tutorials/gif_animation_generator_langgraph.ipynb): Building an animation from a prompt.
